message.content: {"note_claim": "Major news outlets have not reported the destruction of the Dimona facility in Iran's March 1, 2026, strikes.", "label": "PARTIAL", "quote": "At least nine people have been killed after an Iranian missile strike on the central Israeli city of Beit Shemesh, as Tehran continues to launch retaliatory attacks a day after Supreme Leader Ayatollah Ali Khamenei was killed", "reason": "The page reports on March 1, 2026 Iranian strikes and names Beit Shemesh as the casualty site without mentioning Dimona, which is consistent with the note but does not directly state that Dimona wasn't destroyed."}
